explanation: Compared against Green Problem 84: Littlewood's problem, whether some ±1 polynomial has |P(z)| = (1+o(1))√N on the circle; Green says 'the answer to this may well be no'. The statement asserts that for every ε > 0 and large N some f has ||f̂(θ)| - √N| ≤ ε√N for all θ. This is the standard reading and is open. Faithful.
